entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return a pair of your garbage cycling shoes! This is absolutely ridiculous. I've never had a worse experience with a product!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF887-12. These things have given me the worst blisters I've ever had! And the cleats were impossible to adjust properly. I want a refund, and I want it now!
I understand your frustration. Thank you for that order number. Let me pull it up... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes was delivered 78 days ago.
And? Don't you dare tell me I'm outside some window! I will light up every review site on the internet. This is unacceptable! Get me your manager right now!
Sir, there's no need for that, I can definitely resolve this for you. I was just confirming the date. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe to return them.
Wait, what? You're just... going to take them back?

Of course. I'm sorry they caused you blisters. I'm processing the return for you now. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. As soon as we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. I didn't expect that. So I just print the label and send them back for the refund?
That's correct. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No... no, that's it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
